json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Mailbox.Left.Table.Header.Title: Title
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Mailbox.Right.Empty.Title: No new messages.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Mailbox.Right.Help.Select: Select a message on the left to see details.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Notify.Periodic.Title: Summary (last {sec}s)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Notify.Periodic.Total: Total: {errors} errors, {warnings} warnings, {fails} fails from {mods} mods
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.AutoBoost.Label: Enable auto-boost when behind
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.AutoBoost.Tooltip:
When the watcher falls behind (e.g. large log writes),
it can temporarily increase chunk size to catch up faster.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.Cap.Label: Boost capacity (MB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.Factor.Label: Boost factor
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.Factor.Tooltip: Multiplier for chunk size during boosting.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.Threshold.Label: Backlog threshold (MB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Adaptive.Threshold.Tooltip: If the unread backlog exceeds this size, boosting activates.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Apply.LoadDefaults.Label: Load Defaults
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Apply.SaveAndApply.Label: Save and Apply
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Cache.Capacity.Label: Cache capacity per mod
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Cache.Capacity.Tooltip:
How many recent messages per mod to keep in memory.
This bounds what "All" can show in the Details view.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Diagnostics.VerboseLogging.Tool:
Writes per-file tail activity, watch-report saves, and heartbeat details to LogWatcher.log.
Useful for diagnosing missed updates or unexpected behaviour.
Leave off in normal use because it generates a lot of output.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.History.DeepScan.Label: Deep scan (parse from beginning on next start)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.History.DeepScan.Tooltip:
When enabled, the watcher parses each tracked log from offset 0 on next (re)start.
Otherwise, it tails from the current file end.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.History.SaveWatch.Label: Save watch to disk
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.History.SaveWatch.Tooltip:
When enabled, the watcher saves the current watch history to disk in real-time.
This allows recovering the watch history after a crash, freeze or accidental closure.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.Cooldown.Label: HUD notification cooldown (sec)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.Cooldown.Tooltip: After firing an HUD notification, wait at least this long before another one.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.Enabled.Label: Enable notifications / mailbox
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.Enabled.Tooltip: When enabled, the Watcher schedules HUD notifications and/or mailbox messages.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.FadeOut.Label: HUD notification fade-out (sec)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.FadeOut.Tooltip: Gradually fades out the HUD notification.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.HUDFontScale.Tool: Scale up or down the HUD font size.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PeriodicEnabled.T:
Every N seconds, summarize new issues since the last summary.
Useful when you want a high-level view of how unstable your load order is.
How often to emit a periodic summary.
Shorter intervals give more frequent updates, longer intervals are quieter.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PeriodicMaxMods.L: Max mods listed per periodic summary
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PeriodicMaxMods.T:
Maximum number of individual mods briefed in each periodic summary.
The rest are grouped as "+N more".
Controls which log levels are considered in a summary.
0 = only errors, 1 = errors + warnings, 2 = errors + warnings + fails.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PinnedCooldown.To:
After alerting for a pinned mod, wait at least this long before
alerting again for the same mod.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PinnedEnabled.Too:
When enabled, pinned mods are watched more closely.
If a pinned mod produces new issues, a short notification is generated
and a detailed entry is added to the Mailbox tab.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PinnedMinIssues.T:
Minimum number of new issues from a pinned mod before an alert is raised.
Higher values reduce spam on noisy mods.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PinnedMinLevel.To: 0 = only errors, 1 = errors + warnings, 2 = errors + warnings + fails.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.PostLoadDelay.Too: After loading a (new) save, wait at least this long before showing notifications.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.StayOn.Label: HUD notification hold-up (sec)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Notifications.StayOn.Tooltip: After firing an HUD notification, wait at least this long before fading out.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.MaxChunk.Label: Max chunk per poll (KB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.MaxChunk.Tooltip:
Maximum data read from each log file per poll.
Larger chunks reduce I/O calls but may cause hitches if too large.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.MaxLine.Label: Max line length (KB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.MaxLine.Tooltip:
Lines longer than this are skipped.
Some logs may have very long lines; adjust as needed.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PapyrusChunk.Label: Max Papyrus chunk per poll (KB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PapyrusChunk.Toolti: Papyrus logs often exceed 1 MB; larger chunks prevent lag.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PapyrusLine.Label: Max Papyrus line length (KB)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PapyrusLine.Tooltip: Maximum line length for Papyrus logs.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PollInterval.Label: Poll interval (ms)
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.PollInterval.Toolti:
How often to check log files for new data.
Lower values increase responsiveness but use more CPU.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.WatchPapyrus.Label: Watch Papyrus logs
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Performance.WatchPapyrus.Toolti:
Enable monitoring of Papyrus script logs.
These logs can be large and may impact performance.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Pause.Label: Pause
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Pause.Tooltip:
Pause watching after the current scan.
Existing results stay visible, but no new live feed until you resume.
This state is persistent on save.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Pausing.Label: Pausing...
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Pausing.Tooltip:
Watcher is finishing the current scan then will pause.
You can resume once it has fully stopped.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Resume.Label: Resume
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.Run.Resume.Tooltip: Resume real-time log watching using the current settings.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.UX.PersistPins.Label: Persist pins to disk
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Settings.UX.PersistPins.Tooltip: When enabled, pinned mods are saved to disk and restored on restart.
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Details.NoData: No data yet for this mod (maybe the log was rotated).
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Details.Title: Mod Details
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.ClearPins.Label: Clear Pins
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.Filter.Label: Filter
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.Opaque.Label: Opaque
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.PinFirst.Label: Pin first
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.ShowPinnedOnly.Label: Show pinned only
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Panel.WarmingUp.Label: Warming up
json:skse_menu_translation/logwatcher:Lo.Watch.Table.Reset.Confirm: Reset all counters and cached lines for:
